title: Red Skull
description: While your HP is at or below [blue]50%[/blue], you have [blue]3[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Conditionally applies Strength based on current HP. When HP drops to 50% or below, 3 Strength is applied. When HP rises above 50%, the Strength is removed. The status indicator shows Active when the condition is met.
